name: Enshrouded
notes: enshrouded_server.json is written on the first start. Stop the server before editing it: the server overwrites it on exit. Set gameSettingsPreset to Custom, or the preset wins over your gameSettings values. The server only opens its queryPort (UDP 15637 by default); game traffic goes through Steam's networking, so friends join with the host and the query port. Older guides also list a gamePort 15636, which current servers don't have. The server writes its log to logs\enshrouded_server.log rather than the console pipe, so Basecamp tails that file. The world is savegame\world0.ksd, plus the game's own savegame\backup\. A clean exit ends the log with 'Close Log file' and writes world0.ksd. Not yet checked: whether Ctrl+Break gives that clean exit.
